findings.title: Public findMany() method removed without replacement
findings.body: The diff deletes `InsightsBookingService.findMany()` and replaces it with `getBaseConditions()`, which returns a raw `Prisma.Sql` fragment rather than running a query. Any existing caller of `findMany` on this class will fail to compile or break at runtime. The PR description only mentions test changes and never mentions this API removal, so it is unclear whether callers were checked or migrated.

findings.title: Caching tests deleted with no replacement
findings.body: The `Caching` describe block (tests for `getAuthorizationConditions` and `getFilterConditions` memoization) is removed entirely rather than ported to the new Sql format. The service still caches via `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions`, so this behavior is now untested.

findings.title: Org-scope test compares ordered arrays whose order is not guaranteed
findings.body: The expected Sql embeds `[org.id, team.id, team2.id, team3.id]` and `[user, user2, user3]` in a fixed order, but the service builds these from repository query results (`findAllByParentId`, `findAllByTeamIds`) with no ORDER BY. Because the test compares the full SQL including parameter values, it may fail or flake when the database returns rows in a different order.

findings.title: Final test runs raw SQL against the denormalized table without the tests having been run
findings.body: The PR itself states the integration tests were not run because of runner configuration problems. The new `$queryRaw` test hardcodes the table name `BookingTimeStatusDenormalized` and quoted camelCase column names, and nothing confirms these match the schema or that the result shape `{ id }` is correct. A failure here would be unverified.

findings.title: PR description misstates the scope of the change
findings.body: The title and description describe a test-only update that 'works with the new Prisma.sql format that was previously converted in the service implementation'. The diff actually converts the service from Prisma object filters to Prisma.sql, removes findMany, changes the constructor option type, and alters team/org condition behavior (empty user lists are now omitted rather than producing `IN []`). None of this is called out, so reviewers may not assess the behavioral change.
